about: Whole forecast runs, one row per run shape: the per-card peak each measured (out_of_memory rows: at_least_mib, what the card held plus the request that failed), with the physics it ran (route, suite) and the card count (cards; same-host ranks, one per card). hexcore.card_fit prices a plan from the rows of the physics and card regime it runs. Every row before 2026-10-28 is an ArWen-route run (hex 0.4.3 / 0.4.4, before 0.4.6 made MPAS physics the default). Rows with a profile (e.g. hrrr-like-aerosol, 0.4.10's regional GFS cold-start default through physics-default recipe_rules) are that profile's runs; rows with none are the plain suite. A row's runtime (or forecast_wall_seconds over hours) is the forecast stage's measured wall; hexcore.card_fit prices a plan's runtime only from the rows of the same route on the same card at the same card count. A row's card memory is its card's (hexcore.mesh_point.CARD_ALIASES) unless card_capacity_mib says the run was held to less (a ballast process holding the rest of the card): at each size a plan takes the runs measured with the card memory nearest its own card's from above, else the most below, since a roomy card's peak carries kept idle pool sets and free-sized tiles a tight card's does not.
